calls.title: Chris Newton and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting was centered around the need to clean and convert leads into marketing contacts, as only 7,000 out of 50,000-60,000 leads had been converted. A significant number of new contacts (3,600) have been sourced from the Rio integration, but leads from other platforms like Mongo and Stripe also require conversion. The team discussed HubSpot's 7,000 marketing contact limit, which poses challenges for email marketing, and they planned to monitor and possibly upgrade the system as needed. A new segmentation strategy was proposed to exclude paying customers from marketing emails to reduce overlap, while a more refined lead scoring model was developed, with designated roles for implementation. Additionally, integration challenges with syncing data across platforms like Customer IO and LinkedIn were acknowledged, calling for resolution to improve operational efficiency.
calls.keywords: Lead Scoring, Marketing Contacts, HubSpot Integration, Rio Data, Customer IO, Email List Cleanup

# Chris Newton and Ashley Stirrup
Date: 2026-10-28 | Duration: 11.640000343322754m

## Summary
The team tested the HubSpot contact and default booking workflows. Contacts could be filtered for HubSpot users, guest emails copied from records, and booking links generated, although Sarah was not yet visible in HubSpot. The default flow worked by signing in, entering the guest email, selecting the podcast guest booking link, and submitting the form. A test link opened successfully and showed Scott as the assigned booking owner, but the test booking was later cancelled. The team agreed to retain the default booking tool because it supports round-robin tracking, automatically counts meetings, and removes cancelled meetings from totals. Key risks include links that Chris said may expire after 24 or 48 hours, while Ashley noted that podcast guests may need weeks to coordinate. The team also needs to confirm whether Scott remains assigned after a later booking and whether the blank page shown after cancellation creates a confusing guest experience. Chris will investigate expiration and ownership behavior, Jake will regenerate links for follow-ups, and Ashley will apply the process to Sarah’s upcoming recording after the open questions are resolved.

## Keywords
HubSpot, Booking links, Round-robin assignment, Link expiration, Podcast guest scheduling, Contact ownership

## Action Items
**Chris Newton**
Check cancellation destination (05:27)
Investigate booking-link expiration (09:41)
Verify contact ownership (10:05)
